Senses.Explanation: At the edge of the red flesh locates a saying at the living body’s fleshly boundary. Guxue says that everyone there stands like a wall ten thousand fathoms high; three independent retellings preserve layman Zhang Zi’s verse in which a thief departs there when a bell sounds.
